concepts.gloss_en: The plain/literal meaning of the Torah (peshat) — the object/level of Torah itself

members.note: representative; the plain sense of Torah as such

concepts.gloss_en: The STUDY of the plain meaning of Torah — an activity/state (a form of 'sleep'), distinct from the peshat itself

members.note: construct head is לימוד (study of); per rule 4 an action about X ≠ X, even though closely related in Torah 35

notes: Token overlap only. In LM I:35 both are tightly linked (studying peshat = a bechina of sleep), but 'the study of peshat' is an activity while 'peshata d'oraita' is the level of Torah itself. Kept separate per the possessed/construct-head rule (under-merge beats over-merge).
